conviction_note: The findings add up to +0.1: two small one-in-a-few-chances positives (a forecast raise this company has never made at a Q3 print, and an IEEPA tariff refund it applied for and left out of its forecast) against one small negative (the June-August quarter's operating profit is probably down year on year, inside a plan that already assumes second-half operating profit down 46%). The scaled number is 0 because p_up is 50 on balanced, mostly inferential evidence, and abs_move is 2.0, under the 3.59 proxy, because the proxy is driven by H1 and full-year prints while this name's two measurable Q3 reactions were -0.76% and -0.31%.
bar: Company FY11/2026 plan, unchanged since 2025-12-25: sales 92.5bn yen, OP 6.6bn, ordinary 7.1bn, NP 4.8bn (H1 短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260629/140120260624578031.pdf). The market's own number is a one-analyst consensus of ordinary 7.7bn, 8.5% above the plan and unchanged for 4 weeks (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7965). That is ONE estimate source, short of the two agreeing sources the rule asks for, so every size here is capped small. I expect the 9M run-rate to be consistent with the 7.7bn consensus, hence 0.0.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-09-29: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0) (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 0.07 (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7965), which looks like margin shorts at 14x margin longs. Zojirushi's 株主優待 has a November record date (last cum-day 2026-11-18, https://kabutan.jp/stock/yutai?code=7965), so the short side is most likely hedged 優待クロス positions building ahead of the record date, not directional shorts that could be squeezed. The baseline's margin_overhang component (+0.577 of the +0.723 priced_lean) is therefore probably overstated. There is no option skew in Japan. 20d run-up -2.91%, 5d -1.85%. The stock is back at 1,434 yen, the same price as the close before the H1 print (2026-06-29), having fallen 7% to 1,334 the next day.

findings.finding: A full-year forecast raise at this print would be a genuine surprise, and one is possible but unlikely. H1 OP of 5,212m is already 79% of the 6,600m plan, which leaves an implied second half of 1,388m against 2,566m last year. The company said in the H1 短信 that 足元の業績は想定を上回る but held the plan for naphtha and yen costs. Yet across every year from 2013 to 2025 on the TDnet record it has never filed a 業績予想の修正 at a Q3 print: its revisions come in March, June or December.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Forecast revisions have moved this stock hard: the 2025-06-26 H1 revision with a special dividend and buyback produced +22.4% on 2025-07-01 (Yahoo bars), and the pre-full-year revisions of 2024-12-12 and 2025-12-19 were followed by full-year prints that fell 4.1% and 4.3%. The Q3 prints, with no revision, moved -0.76% (2024-09-26) and -0.31% (2025-09-30).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The single analyst already sits at ordinary 7.7bn against the 7.1bn plan, and holding the plan is the expected outcome given the company's habit, so a hold costs nothing. What is not priced is the tail case of a raise, which I put at roughly 15% for about +3%. If the market expected a raise, the stock would have run up into the print rather than drifting 2.9% lower over 20 days.
findings.independence: Revision timing comes from the irbank disclosure list (https://irbank.net/7965/ir), a different document from the 短信. The consensus comes from kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7965).

findings.finding: The US subsidiary has filed IEEPA tariff refund claims, which the H1 短信 explicitly kept out of the FY forecast. CBP began paying Phase 1 refunds on 2026-04-20, and a Japanese peer (6694) disclosed refunds received from May to July 2026 that it booked as an extraordinary gain. Zojirushi's Q3 (2026-05-21 to 08-20) may therefore carry a refund the plan does not include.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior refund line for this name. The nearest analogue is the 2023-12-22 fixed-asset-sale extraordinary gain, which was announced with the full-year print, so its reaction cannot be separated from that print.
findings.why_not_priced: The claim itself is public, but its size and timing are not: the company called both uncertain and gave no number. If the market were pricing a refund, the kabuyoho consensus would have moved after June and it has not moved in four weeks. My own estimate of the size is an inference (US sales of roughly 10bn yen a year at blended IEEPA rates): a few hundred million yen at most, booked mostly as an extraordinary gain below operating income, so it is sized at a fraction of the same money as operating profit and weighted by about a 50% chance it lands in Q3.
findings.independence: Peer receipt timing: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/66940/140120260813519268.pdf (2026-08-13). The CBP Phase 1 start date and the 80-day rule are from PwC Japan's customs note, https://www.pwc.com/jp/ja/taxnews-indirect-tax/assets/cta-20260430-jp.pdf, as summarised in search results (snippet_only).

findings.finding: Operating profit for the June-August quarter is probably down year on year against last year's 690m. Q2 three-month OP fell 41% (879m against 1,494m) on cost inflation. The yen averaged around 158 against roughly 146-148 a year earlier, while the H1 plan assumes 155. The company itself flagged naphtha and yen costs. JEMA's domestic rice-cooker shipments were -16.4% in June (snippet) and -1.8% in August, with July positive. The last time a quarterly decline led the headline (2026-06-30) the stock fell 7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026 reactions have tracked the three-month OP change: Q1 OP +28% YoY gave +11.07% (2026-03-31) and Q2 OP -41% gave -6.97% (2026-06-30), both from Yahoo bars. Q3 in prior years was a small quarter (OP 108m in FY24, 690m in FY25), and those prints moved under 1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced, and the argument against this finding is strong. The full-year plan already assumes second-half OP down 46%, so a weak Q3 lands inside guidance. The stock has also fully recovered its post-H1 drop (1,334 back to 1,434), which says holders are looking through the cost squeeze. What would show this as priced is a slide into the print; the 20-day drift of -2.9% is mild. The finding is sized small for both reasons and because it rests on an industry proxy plus FX rather than a company number.
findings.independence: Q2 three-month OP and the cost commentary come from the H1 短信 and kabutan's quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7965), a different source from JEMA. The June JEMA figure is from a search snippet of https://www.jema-net.or.jp/stat/evefa20000004jb4-att/2606ds-comment.pdf (snippet_only: curl returned 404).

findings.finding: The baseline's long-leaning priced_lean (+0.72, of which +0.58 is margin overhang from a 信用倍率 of 0.07) most likely reflects 優待クロス short hedges built ahead of the November 株主優待 record date, not squeezable directional shorts.
findings.why_not_priced: Not directional. It argues that the baseline's lean should not be read as squeeze fuel, so no squeeze premium belongs in the number.
findings.independence: JPX register shows zero disclosed shorts (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html), consistent with hedged retail cross positions rather than institutional shorts.

outside_window.finding: Further IEEPA refund applications under later CBP phases, which the company said it will file once requirements and timing are set, plus the usual pre-full-year forecast revision this company files in mid to late December.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely (~15%). The company has not revised at a Q3 print in 2013-2025, although H1 progress is 79% of OP and the single-analyst consensus is 8.5% above the plan on ordinary. Returns: none expected; buybacks and the special dividend have come at H1 or full year, never at Q3. New-year guide: not applicable at Q3. Quarter: 9M OP will probably be ~85-90% of the plan against ~75% at the same stage in FY24 and FY25 on a final-result basis, which flatters progress, while the three-month OP is probably down YoY.
baseline_tension: The findings net to roughly zero, against a baseline lean of +0.72 that I think is inflated by yutai-cross margin shorts and a mild -2.9% 20-day drift. The strongest positive the release could carry is a forecast raise or a tariff-refund gain. I looked for both: the raise cuts against the company's 12-year habit, and the refund is unquantified. The one negative rests on public series (Q2 trend, JEMA, FX), and holders have already looked through the Q2 drop, so p_up stays at 50.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on public series means p_up toward 50) was already met with p_up at 50 and the negative finding sized small; rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives) does not apply here (two positives, one negative), and the strongest-positive check is written into baseline_tension.
